name: FWCP Annual Grants and Year-round Grants
summary: Grants to compensate for the impacts of BC Hydro dams on fish, wildlife and their habitat in the Coastal, Columbia and Peace regions of British Columbia, through an annual intake plus year-round community engagement, land securement and seed grants.

geography.label: BC Hydro dam watersheds, British Columbia

reporting: reporting and payment milestones as outlined in a guidance document posted in early 2027

calls.label: 2026 annual grant intake

deadline.text: Monday, November 2, 4 p.m. PT / 5 p.m. MT

status.quote: In our Columbia Region, only multi-year proponents approved for funding last year may apply this year. Read our regional guidance documents and review our regional action plans to develop a project idea that fulfills a priority action. Find out more about applying for an FWCP grant in 2026. Watch a recording of our virtual information session. Apply by Monday, November 2, 4 p.m. PT / 5 p.m. MT.
